description: Headline KPIs: revenue, orders, customers, AOV for revenue-recognised orders (status not canceled/unavailable).
output_schema: total_revenue numeric, product_revenue numeric, freight_revenue numeric, total_orders bigint, unique_customers bigint, avg_order_value numeric

description: Monthly revenue with month-over-month growth (LAG window function).
output_schema: month_start date, revenue numeric, orders bigint, prev_revenue numeric, mom_growth_pct numeric

description: Quarterly revenue and quarter-over-quarter growth.
output_schema: quarter_label text, revenue numeric, orders bigint, qoq_growth_pct numeric

description: Year-over-year comparison by calendar month (2018 vs 2017) – self-join on month number.
output_schema: month smallint, month_name text, revenue_2017 numeric, revenue_2018 numeric, yoy_growth_pct numeric

description: Year-to-date revenue Jan–Aug, 2017 vs 2018 (same period comparison, data ends Aug-2018).
output_schema: year smallint, ytd_revenue numeric, ytd_orders bigint, yoy_growth_pct numeric

description: Cumulative (running total) revenue by month, and share of all-time revenue reached.

output_schema: full_date date, revenue numeric, rolling_7d_avg numeric, rolling_30d_avg numeric

description: Revenue and orders by hour of purchase (local timestamp).
output_schema: purchase_hour int, orders bigint, revenue numeric, pct_orders numeric

description: Black Friday 2017 vs average of the 4 preceding same weekdays (dim_date flag).

description: Distribution of customers by number of orders.

description: Top 20 customers by lifetime revenue with RANK and DENSE_RANK.
output_schema: customer_unique_id text, orders bigint, lifetime_revenue numeric, revenue_rank bigint, dense_rank bigint

description: For repeat customers: days between consecutive orders (LAG) – median and percentiles.

description: Top 15 customer cities by revenue.
